newsitem.title: USA: Data Systems sells 50 pct MIS Info. stake.
newsitem.headline: Data Systems sells 50 pct MIS Info. stake.

text.p: Data Systems & Software Inc said on Wednesday it sold its 50 percent stake in M.I.S. Information Systems Holdings Ltd to Geotek Technologies Inc for a $2 million prime rate, unsecured promissory note.
Data Systems said in a statement the sale would result in a net capital gain of about $1 million after taxes and minority interests in the third quarter of 1996.
The Geotek promissory note was due on July 1, 1998, Data Systems said. Geotek Technologies is a subsidiary of Geotek Communications Inc.
Data Systems said the sale was in line with the company's consolidation and development policy.

M.I.S. Informations Systems owns Mobile Information Systems Ltd. It was formed in 1994 as an equally owned joint venture, by the company's subsidiary Decision Systems Israel Ltd and Geotek to develop wireless mobile information systems, software and aplications primarily for Geotek's wireless communication system, Data Systems said.
